findings: Two blocking issues: (1) The JavaScript IR adapter emits empty trueBranch/falseBranch arrays for if/else blocks containing console.log calls, so the YES/NO branch body nodes are never rendered — the primary professor-demo scenario (marks>=40 → Pass/Fail) produces only START→DECISION→END with no branch content. Fix required in server/analyzer/ast/javascriptAdapter.js. (2) The new analyzeSelection() function in client/services/flowchartApi.ts uses catch (err: any), the sole remaining any-typed catch in the file after the lint-fix pass — change to unknown with explicit type narrowing matching the pattern in analyzeFile/analyzeProject.
